title: Run Windows 11 Pro on your Mac with a $9.97 lifetime license
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Run Windows apps on your Mac with a lifetime Windows 11 Pro license, now $9.97 (reg. $199).

Parallels lets you run Windows on a Mac, but you still need a Windows license to install it. Right now, a Microsoft Windows 11 Pro lifetime license is on sale for $9.97 (reg. $199), and you only pay once.

Once Windows 11 Pro is running in Parallels, you can open Windows-only apps and games next to your Mac apps.

Pro also includes tools Windows 11 Home leaves out

  • Hyper-V runs virtual machines, and Windows Sandbox lets you test sketchy apps in an isolated space.
  • BitLocker encrypts your data
  • Azure AD connects to business networks for sign-in and access management.

If you do development, IT work, or anything on a company network, those are the features you need.

The software adds the Windows 11 snap layouts, arranges windows for multitasking, and supports DirectX 12 Ultimate for modern games. Copilot in the taskbar answers questions, summarizes pages, generates images, and writes code on demand.

Each license installs on one machine, isn’t transferable, and needs to be redeemed within 30 days of purchase. Updates are included. Check Microsoft’s Windows 11 system requirements before you buy.

Pay once for Windows on your Mac and skip buying a separate PC.

Through October 4 at 11:59 p.m. PT, you can get Microsoft Windows 11 Pro on sale for $9.97 (reg. $199).
